text: No, the method did not find any tree-cover loss event on this property after 2020. The analysis used data up to 2025, with the JRC 2020 reference confirming 91.77% of the asset was forested in 2020. The corroboration rule required agreement between later years and the JRC reference for any detected loss, but no such events met the criteria. The asset had consistent tree cover (>=30% canopy) since 2000, with no post-2020 losses exceeding the 0.5-ha minimum threshold.
